items.summary: NVG-291 demonstrated statistically significant improvement in gait quality (p=0.0197), based on a Global Statistical Test integrating the established hallmarks of genuine neural recovery into a unified assessment of treatment benefit. items.title: NervGen Pharma Announces Successful End-of-Phase 2 Meeting and FDA Alignment on RESTORE, a Phase 3 Registrational Study of NVG-291 for Chronic Tetraplegia

Primary endpoint will be the change from baseline in GRASSP Quantitative Prehension at Week 12, a validated functional endpoint designed to capture improvement in fine-motor hand use, the highest priority domain in tetraplegia.
